findings.mechanism: Each Hub.Open starts a per-subscription worker goroutine (run) with a 4KB scratch buffer and channels.
findings.cause: Suspected goroutine-per-subscription leak; but Handler.Serve defers sub.Close() right after Open, on every path (push error, flush error, normal). Close closes done and blocks on exited, so the worker returns before Serve returns.
findings.evidence: Ran 5 batches x 20000 Serve calls via workload.MakeRequest in a scratch test (removed afterwards), forcing GC after each batch: goroutines stayed at 2, HeapAlloc ~143-151KB (flat), Sys constant at 13.2MB. go test ./... passes.
findings.discriminator: Goroutine count is constant (2) and heap is flat after each batch; every worker is joined by Close (<-s.exited) before Serve returns.

findings.mechanism: MemorySink keeps only counters and a checksum, not messages; Hub.opened is an atomic counter; Renderer layouts map is fixed-size and copied once.
findings.cause: Looked like possible accumulating state in long-lived objects.
findings.evidence: Code review plus the flat heap measurement above over 100000 requests.
findings.discriminator: No collection field grows with traffic; only int/uint32 counters change.
